an4.4:1.1: Catusu bhikkhave micchāpaṭipajjamāno bālo avyatto asappuriso khataṃ upahataṃ attānaṃ pariharati sāvajjo ca hoti sānuvajjo ca viññūnaṃ bahuñ ca apuññaṃ pasavati.
an4.4:1.3: Mātari bhikkhave micchāpaṭipajjamāno bālo avyatto asappuriso khataṃ upahataṃ attānaṃ pariharati sāvajjo ca hoti sānuvajjo ca viññūnaṃ bahuñ ca apuññaṃ pasavati,
an4.4:1.4: pitari bhikkhave micchāpaṭipajjamāno . . . pe . . . Tathāgate bhikkhave micchāpaṭipajjamāno . . . pe . . . Tathāgatasāvake bhikkhave micchāpaṭipajjamāno bālo avyatto asappuriso khataṃ upahataṃ attānaṃ pariharati sāvajjo ca hoti sānuvajjo ca viññūnaṃ bahuñ ca apuññaṃ pasavati.
an4.4:1.5: Imesu kho bhikkhave micchāpaṭipajjamāno bālo . . . bahuñ ca apuññaṃ pasayati. 2.
an4.4:2.1: Catusu bhikkhave sammāpaṭipajjamāno paṇḍito vyatto sappuriso akkhataṃ anupahataṃ attānaṃ pariharati anavajjo ca hoti ananuvajjo ca viññūnaṃ bahuñ ca puññaṃ pasavati.
an4.4:2.3: Mātari bhikkhave sammāpaṭipajjamāno paṇḍito vyatto sappuriso akkhataṃ anupahataṃ attānaṃ pariharati anavajjo ca hoti ananuvajjo ca viññunaṃ bahuñ ca puññaṃ pasavati,
an4.4:2.4: pitari bhikkhave sammāpaṭipajjamāno . . . pe . . . Tathāgate bhikkhave sammāpaṭipajjamāno . . . pe . . . Tathāgatasāvake bhikkhave sammāpaṭipajjamāno paṇḍito vyatto sappuriso akkhataṃ anupahataṃ attānaṃ pariharati anavajjo ca hoti ananuvajjo ca viññūnaṃ bahuñ ca puññaṃ pasavati.
an4.4:2.5: Imesu kho bhikkhave sammāpaṭipajjamāno paṇḍito . . . bahuñ ca puññaṃ pasavatīti. 3.
